dcterms:description: Traffic data collected at a backbone link of a Tier1 ISP between Chicago and Seattle in 2016. Each recording session is around one hour, with approximately 30 million packets and 1 million unique flows per minute.
dcterms:title: Internet Traffic Dataset

dcterms:description: AOL query log dataset consisting of 21 million search queries collected from 650 thousand users over 90 days. Each query is a search phrase with multiple words, and the distribution of search query frequency follows the Zipfian law.
dcterms:title: AOL Query Log Dataset
